candidate_reports.remark: A wind gust of 60 mph was recorded at the Marathon 21N TTU mesonet station.
Lea County Emergency Management relayed a report of seven power lines down south of Monument on State Highway 8. Power lines also down near the intersection of Maddox and Pearl Valley Roads. Time est
Damage to metal roof and overturned travel trailer.
Emergency management reports section of roof blown off a residence and 2-4 inch in diameter tree branches broken.
Reports of trees and power lines down as well as damage to car ports within a 3 block radius of 26th Street and Ave O in Snyder.
Mesonet station UR103 2.2 E Colorado City (UPR) reported a wind gust of 60 mph.
Mesonet station 105 5NW Colorado City reported a wind gust of 67 mph.
Storm chaser reported dense blowing dust associated with an outflow boundary via social media. Visibility dropped to a 1/4 mile for at least two minutes (duration of video).
Mesonet station 55 5SW St. Lawrence_ TX.
ASOS station KMAF Midland.
Report from NWS Employee of brief near zero visibility along with a recorded non-thunderstorm wind gust of 50 mph at KMAF.
Mesonet station FW9693 Pyote recorded a non-thunderstorm wind gust associated with an outflow boundary.
ASOS station KFST Fort Stockton measured a non-thunderstorm wind gust associated with an outflow boundary.
EM reported roadway flooding along Highway 84_ FM 1611_ and other side roads.
Report of water over the road at the intersection of Hwy 349 and I-20.
Report of most intersections and residential street flooding on West Wadley Ave near Loop 250.
Report of one foot of water over the road on FM2400 near TX 349. Time was estimated by radar in which this occurred anytime between noon and 3pm.
Terrell County Fire Chief reported 6 inches of rainfall and flood water having washed up some pavement along HWY 349_ near RM 3166.
Report of a completely washed out unpaved road near Chandler Ranch from heavy rainfall and river flooding from Independence Creek.
Floodwater washed out part of the pavement along HWY 349.
Received video of flooding out of Geddis Canyon south of Terrell Gas Plant.
Flash flooding still occurring near Chandler Ranch.
Report of water rushing over the road on FM 2400.
The Snyder Fire Department reports flash flooding along several streets in the community of Snyder.
Pecos County Emergency Management reported street flooding in Fort Stockton_ especially at low-water crossings.
Trained spotter reports flash flooding at the intersection of State Hwy 176 and FM 1212.
Emergency Management reported flash flooding in Andrews_ particularly around the city lake. A few cars were reported stalled due to flood waters.
Off-duty NWS employee reported flash flooding in Gardendale. 0.8 inches of rain fell in approximately 15 minutes.
Public report of flash flooding on Louisiana Avenue in Midland.
Report from mPING: Flash flooding occurring on North Midland Drive.
Broadcast media relayed a picture from the public of flash flooding in Monahans.
Broadcast media relayed a picture from the public of flash flooding on roadways in Kermit.
Broadcast media relayed a picture from the public of flash flooding at the intersection of Wadley and Ward in Midland.
HAM radio operator reported that the intersection of Highway 349 and CR 130 is underwater.
Report from mPING: Flash flooding of streets and roads occurring in West Odessa.
Lea County EM reports water covering the road at the intersection of U.S. 380 and SH 206 in Tatum.
Lea County EM reports road closures due to flash flooding at Ave R from Main to 9th and Eddy Street from Ave D to Washington_ and SH 18 from Commercial to just outside of the city limits in Lovington
Report from mPING: Flash flooding in Colorado City.
Public report on social media of flash flooding on Buffalo Gap Street in the Lone Star Community of north Midland.
Report from mPING: Flash flooding occurring near Luther.
Reports of flash flooding with up to 1 foot water covering the road in places near the intersection of SH 176 and 137.
Pictures of flash flooding on streets in and near Alpine received on social media. Also pictures of flash flooding along creeks.
Delayed report: a member of the public posted a picture on social media of a sign blown over in front of the MCM Elegante in Odessa. The time of occurrence is estimated from radar.
Delayed report: broadcast media relayed reports of a few power outages and some tree damage in Odessa. An uprooted tree was reported near Hammett Drive. The time of occurrence is estimated from radar
